title: note-event
description: One note. Pitch is CONCERT-PITCH MIDI everywhere; only the display transposes (B-flat clarinet written = concert + 2 semitones; guitar written an octave above sounding; trombone is concert pitch in bass clef). Times are song time at 1.0x tempo, in seconds from the start of the piece.

pitch.description: Concert-pitch MIDI note number (60 = middle C).

onset_beat.description: Start in beats from the start of the piece, quantized to the tempo grid (1 = one quarter note).

part.description: Id of the part this note belongs to.
